decision: Recommend the first three proposed complete values and replace the fourth minimal noun proposal with an atomic four-resource width/height/unit composition repair.

entries.english: App language\n\nTranslations are maintained in AN Paint’s language resources. New or untranslated text appears in English.
entries.old: See keeleversioon sisaldab kogu AN Painti tõlgitavat kasutajaliidese teksti.
entries.recommended: Rakenduse keel\n\nTõlkeid hallatakse AN Painti keeleressurssides. Uus või tõlkimata tekst kuvatakse inglise keeles.
entries.rationale: The old text claims all translatable UI text is included and omits the English-fallback caveat. The complete replacement accurately follows the current source and restores the picker heading, needed because the note is the custom title. Keeleressurssides is technical but understandable; no unneeded stylistic rewrite is warranted.
entries.confidence_and_limits: High source-fidelity confidence; medium-high wording confidence; no claim that all fallback or runtime layout paths were tested.

entries.english: The export was created. Use Save or Save as to save the current image before continuing.
entries.old: Eksport loodi. Enne jätkamist salvesta praegune pilt käsuga Salvesta või Salvesta kui.
entries.recommended: Eksport loodi. Enne jätkamist salvesta praegune pilt käsuga Salvesta või Salvesta nimega.
entries.rationale: Salvesta kui does not match the actual Save as command Salvesta nimega…. The proposal restores command-name identity while retaining the export-versus-save distinction and required action before continuing. Omitting the menu ellipsis inside running prose is appropriate. The retained opening Eksport loodi is understandable and faithful; it is not certified as the uniquely best stylistic translation.
entries.confidence_and_limits: High for command identity and meaning; medium-high for the full sentence.
complete_examples: Eksport loodi. Enne jätkamist salvesta praegune pilt käsuga Salvesta või Salvesta nimega.

usage_evidence.support: Official Microsoft Estonian help uses Salvesta nimega as the Save as command. Internal AN Paint menu identity is the decisive evidence.

entries.rationale: ImageDimensions permits 1×1, so the old bare count can be 1 pikslit, which violates the singular form. Pikslite arv introduces a noun phrase followed by a value and works for 1 and larger counts without a plural resource. It also faithfully follows the current English Pixel count formulation. Every numeric token and both units remain unchanged.
entries.confidence_and_limits: High for grammatical defect, proposed count neutrality, source fidelity and placeholder preservation; localized Android numeric punctuation not executed.

grammar_evidence.support: EKI states that numeral+noun nominative phrases normally have the noun in the partitive, except numeral one. The particular pixel-summary judgment is an application of that rule.

entries.rationale: Use the whole label Laius pikslites or Laius protsentides. This P2 template must accompany the unit changes because the same dedicated unit values feed both width and height.
Use the whole label Kõrgus pikslites or Kõrgus protsentides, maintaining the actual height-input meaning and unit.
entries.confidence_and_limits: Medium-high, with composition and consumer verified.

entries.rationale: Use pikslites with both templates shortened to dimension plus unit. Existing pikslit is a count form with no preceding count in these consumers. Minimal piksel repairs that local mismatch but leaves a less idiomatic full label.
entries.confidence_and_limits: Medium-high; bounded to the current verified consumers.

entries.rationale: Use protsentides under both shortened templates. This is required by the idiomatic composition; no change to the standalone Protsent radio label.
entries.confidence_and_limits: Medium-high; bounded to the current verified consumers.

dimension_composition.minimal_proposal: Laius ühikus piksel / Kõrgus ühikus piksel
dimension_composition.minimal_judgment: Understandable and a grammatical improvement over the existing partitive pikslit, but literal and unnecessarily cumbersome for accessible field labels. Do not call it a false meaning or a severe functional defect; prefer the idiomatic complete labels below.
dimension_composition.existing_percent_judgment: Laius/Kõrgus ühikus protsent is understandable. Changing protsent to protsentides is the corresponding compositional adjustment, not an allegation that the isolated noun protsent is wrong.
dimension_composition.atomic_dependency: Change both templates and both dedicated lower-case unit resources together. Leaving either template as ühikus %1$s would yield the bad combination ühikus pikslites/protsentides. Do not alter ui_pixels=Pikslid or ui_percent=Protsent, which name the separate visible radio choices.
dimension_composition.p2_boundary: ui_width_in is one explicitly identified P2 counterpart required by this shared-unit repair. This does not broaden the review to other P2 wording.

dimension_composition.confidence: High that all four recommended compositions accurately convey the dimension and selected unit; medium-high linguistic confidence as a source-backed model review, not a native-speaker sign-off.

usage_evidence.support: Official Estonian Microsoft page uses the full heading Laius pikslites and related width/height-in-pixels forms. This corroborates usage, not app accessibility behavior.
EKI collocation entry for väljendama includes protsentides väljendama, confirming the natural in-percent construction. Applying it to these dimension labels is the reviewer’s grammatical judgment.
